reasons.fluidity: Corridor telemetry recorded two steady-state spikes over 33.3 ms after live interaction.
reasons.text_density: Visible English lines and interaction labels were concise; no untranslated text was observed.
reasons.action_sfx_integrity: The run covered character selection and dialogue, without a complete skeletal-and-SFX measurement.
reasons.audio_loudness: Final FFmpeg audio postprocess timed out; retained live telemetry is not a final audio measurement.
reasons.blind_narrative_match: No canonical-plot comparison was supplied to the blind tester.
reasons.aesthetic_similarity: No Astra target image was supplied for visual comparison.
reasons.narrative_flow: Selectable group dialogue communicated clues and directed the player to the Kitchen.
